paragraphs.text: Saskia the Unyielding is a legendary human soldier from an unknown plane .

Saskia was the sole survivor of a massacre conducted against her village by an invading army that came from across the sea. The warrior tradition of her people demands the survivors of a battle to erect a monument of stones for the fallen — a task Saskia worked at in solitude for almost ten years. As news of her labor spread among her people, thousands of warriors journeyed to see Saskia place the final stone upon this symbol of defiance.
With the monument complete, her mind turned from mourning to vengeance. With axe in hand and a host at her back, Saskia brought war to the doorsteps of her enemies.
